_note: Kishotenketsu, the four-part structure from East Asian storytelling. It needs no central conflict: ki introduces, sho develops, ten turns the story with something unexpected, ketsu brings it together and shows what it means.
name: kishotenketsu
label: Kishōtenketsu
blurb: Four beats and no required conflict: introduce, develop, a surprising turn, then reconcile. Quiet stories where the twist changes how everything reads.
